bullets.content: [general] One factor per solve means ONE. List differences from the last solved mesh before each mesh()/solve(); if 2 or more, split them. Bundled changes (h+edges, edge add+refine) were unattributable and lost score.

[general] Spend solves as: (1) exact best-known control, (2) control + ONE change, (3) one more single-factor change on the winner, (4) optional. Pair each candidate with compare(finest, candidate). Multi-factor changes (h plus 3-4 refinements) were unattributable.
[general] Use all 4 solves, never leave one unused: S1 explorer mesh; S2-S3 drop or change one new box each; S4 best variant. view(error) after each; compare(best, runner-up) before submit.

[general] Never issue mesh() calls in parallel: solve() uses the last mesh that finished (solved 7787 nodes instead of planned 5665). Re-issue the intended mesh() alone right before solve() and check node count matches plan.
[general] Reference-free error estimate underpredicts true error (~1.6x on bc7, 11.4% vs ~10% on bc0). Assume true error ~1.1-1.5x the estimate; don't pick the cheapest mesh on estimates alone.
[general] compare showed 17% stress difference between 20k and 24k DOF meshes: similar eta values are not convergence. Vary one factor per solve and read view(error) after each.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: re-runs reproduce nodes and energy to 6 digits (0.0332980 J; h0.0045 recipe 0.033794 J/27.1k). Search the playbook for the exact recipe before solving; treat logged energies as free controls and solve only new meshes.

[general] Write the first message answering every feedback item before any tool call (missed twice). After EVERY solve call view(kind=error), read the region grid, list hotspot local h, aim the next single change there. Before submit compare() the two finalists (never compare(n,n)).
[general] Before solving, check boxes cover every region the previous error map flags, including the far end of the part (top ring was missed).
[general] Price ideas with free mesh() calls: reject any refinement adding >10% nodes unless hotspots show >=10% error share inside it (upper box 0.0038 gave +26% nodes).

[general] Before submit, list estimated score per candidate: ((0.3186/(1.22*eta))/2)^2/(DOFs/6057) on bc7. Submit the max. If within 2%, take lower check-point error. Never let reasoning and action disagree.

[general] 11-18% compare() diff between structurally different meshes is real field change, not noise. Accept a change if % energy gain ≥ ~0.04 × % DOF change near the plateau (estimate); otherwise submit the cheaper mesh.
[general] Above target score is g/(2c), but a node floor (~5.4k on bc0) caps DOF cuts. Raise accuracy per node instead: a 1-point field error drop at fixed DOFs is worth ~+0.06 base (estimate).
[general] Setup verified for bc7 (3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, f2 fixed, f23 4e6 Pa, f16 2.1e6 Pa): all error is discretisation, reuse verbatim.

[general] After meshing read 'element size near group' and hotspot local h. If a 0.0024 sub-box delivers >0.0031 at hotspots it is swallowed: drop size to 0.0021 rather than enlarging extent. Check quality.min ≥0.15 for 0.0024 boxes inside h 0.008.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Explorer S1: drop edge 22, add arc-END root boxes at 0.0018 (+y and -y, see next mesh). Expect end hotspots h <=0.0026 and SE above a6's 2.13391e-4. Corner box: S2 drops only it to measure value vs break-even 0.03% SE per +1% DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never omit the root box: edges 22/18 at 0.002 r0.003 without it gave h 0.0037 at all six root hotspots and field 11.4%, vs 8.3-9.0% with root box 0.0025 plus 0.0016 sub-boxes.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Wall box [0.012,-0.025,-0.0081,0.031,0.012,0.0081] stays at 0.0035. At 0.0045 it gave 0.0064 mid-wall on f5 (hotspot 5.6% at z≈+0.0015) and upper-wall f7 cell 5.6% low.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] h >=0.0085 switches gmsh to a curvature branch that over-refines small low-stress faces f27-f32/f34 (h 0.008: 7787 nodes; h 0.02: 6543). Keep h 0.0074-0.0078. The coarse h 0.01 recipe had cost term 0.544 at 16.2k DOFs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Edge refinement along root edges lags (0.002 gave 0.0037; 0.0016 r0.002 gave +0.085% SE for +5.7% nodes, break-even ~0.17%). Don't use edges finer than 0.002; put fine size in thin boxes z -0.0081..-0.0055.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] If explorer mesh exceeds ~6400 nodes or quality.min <0.105, coarsen the corner box 0.0022→0.0025 first. Never coarsen f5/f7 sub-boxes (top hotspots 9-13% each).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a6: sub-boxes at 0.0016 put top hotspots at h 0.0024-0.0029, field 8.38% at 17.6k DOFs. Use as base. Grid cells (0.0253,-0.0115,-0.006) and (0.0253,0.0144,-0.006) show 31-33% local error: boxes must span the full strip y -0.01..0.015.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Error sits in thin strip z -0.0073..-0.0068, x 0.018-0.027 along f5/f7 just above clamp f12, local h ~0.0031, 5-6% vM error. Gains must come from this strip; global h barely affects it. Don't shrink strip box below 0.0026 without cutting DOFs elsewhere.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Judge each explorer box by energy vs a6's mesh (2.13391e-4 J at 5878 nodes; don't re-solve): keep a box only if dSE% x 33 > dDOF%. Confirm arc-end hotspot h <0.0027.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] P2 at (0.0217,-0.0209) is -15%; hidden worst near f13 around y -0.0375. Check f13 and P2 area get h about 0.004, not >=0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle/rim pockets hold junction error: |x| 0.012-0.0195, |y| 0.007-0.011, z 0.020-0.031, 2.6-3.5% each at h 0.0038-0.0042, 13-20% vM. Two mirrored boxes at 0.0024 r0.002 should give h≈0.0029, hotspots roughly halved (estimate).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Under saddle boxes coarsen full-ring junction box to 0.0038 with global h 0.008, freeing DOFs from caps f15/f17/f25/f21. If over ~8000 nodes (~24k DOFs), raise junction box to 0.0040, never the saddle boxes.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a2 (rank 1, base 0.237, 24.4k): coarse h 0.0095 with volume boxes beats fine uniform h. Backbone (junction ring, upper 0.0046-0.0048, lower 0.0044-0.0046, f2 0.0033) ≈7750 nodes. Put extra DOFs into saddle pockets, not edges 8/39.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp-edge refinements are break-even: edge 3 0.0026 added 102 nodes; edge 40 at 0.0022 gave +4.6% DOFs for +0.19% energy; four ring boxes 0.003 gave +9% nodes, no gain. Keep only {f2, 0.003, r0.005}. Edges 39/8/40 at 0.003 r0.004, never finer.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Global h is a poor lever: h 0.0045 (27.1k) vs 0.005 (24.2k) changed field error 16.7→16.4% while cost rose 12%, base 0.227→0.212. Don't go below h 0.005. Get the clamp ring from f2 0.003 r0.005.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Contested cells: lower barrel bottom z≈0.005 (|y|≈0.013, x -0.017..-0.006), 5% spread. Keep lower box [-0.022,-0.0185,0,0.022,0.0185,0.021] ≤0.0044 r0.003 at h≥0.007; confirm f22/f23 touching h ≤0.0042.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z 0.055-0.057 by bore f20 holds ~18% of error (hotspot 22.8% vM) at h 0.0043-0.0045; f2 0.003 r0.005 gives only ~0.0043. Finer global h is the lever; or self idea: top box [-0.02,-0.02,0.048,0.02,0.02,0.061] 0.003 r0.003 (watch DOFs, one change).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Top clamp ring cells (z≈0.056, four quadrants) hold 3.4-3.9% each; f2 gave h only 0.0038. Test top box [-0.02,-0.02,0.050,0.02,0.02,0.061] at 0.003 and offset DOFs by raising h.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction hotspots z 0.020-0.031 near f20/f13/f9/f16 had h 0.0040-0.0042 (13-19% vM); box 0.0033 was swallowed. Try 0.0027 over band z 0.019-0.032 only (saddle boxes now cover this).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a6: single wide junction box [-0.024,-0.014,0.019,0.024,0.014,0.036] at 0.0036 gave best base (0.228, 17.6%) at 21810 DOFs. A box covering both saddles plus f20 bore beats face groups or edges.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] h scan (junction 0.0031 + lower 0.0045 + f2): h 0.0085 0.033262/20.7k; 0.0065 0.033560/22.3k; 0.0055 0.033646/23.9k. h>=0.0085 loses too much; 0.0065-0.0055 tie. Self: 0.0065→0.0055 gave +7% DOFs for 0.3% energy, poor lever at that range.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Control recipe (best base 0.221): h 0.0055, order 2, f2 0.003 r0.005, edges 40/39/8 at 0.002 r0.004: 20430 DOFs, field 18.5%, check 5.67%, energy 0.033298 J. Solve 1 = this exact call; confirm DOFs and energy match to measure noise.
